summary: Richard Spotts, President of the Montebello Ecology Council, opposes unregulated ORV use on public lands. He argues that while the draft Environmental Statement acknowledges potential damage from ORV use, it does not go far enough in encouraging necessary regulation. He calls for strict monitoring, regulation, and limitation of all ORV use to specific areas where detrimental effects can be minimized, and urges the Secretary to support the Sierra Club and Desert Protective Council's positions on the matter.
